summary: Backup Pro is an open-source Flutter-based FolderSync replacement for Android (and eventually iOS). It securely archives folders, SMS, and call logs to a personal NAS over an SMB connection. It features a premium UI/UX design, resilient file transfer protocols, home screen widgets, and automated GitHub-to-Play-Store deployments.

concepts.title: Flutter UI & State
concepts.description: Cross-platform user interface for configuring NAS credentials, sync folders, and backup schedules.

concepts.title: Premium Design System
concepts.description: Establishes a consistent premium brand, color palette, strict Light/Dark mode definitions, and unified button animations.

concepts.title: Live Transfer Dashboard
concepts.description: Displays loading screens, real-time transfer speeds, and smooth progress bars during active backups.

concepts.title: Home Screen Widget
concepts.description: Native Android home screen widgets (in 3 sizes) displaying latest backup status, run time, and a manual 'Backup Now' button.
concepts.notes: Requires native Android integration (e.g. via home_widget plugin) and bridges state from WorkManager.

concepts.title: System & Lockscreen Alerts
concepts.description: Provides OS-level notifications and lockscreen updates for background progress and completion states.

concepts.title: Background Scheduler
concepts.description: Periodically triggers the backup process based on constraints like Wi-Fi and charging state.
concepts.notes: Relies on Android WorkManager (via Flutter plugins). Must handle battery optimization restrictions gracefully.

concepts.title: Persistent Foreground Service
concepts.description: Promotes the app to a foreground state with a sticky notification during active transfers so Android doesn't kill it.

concepts.title: Network Context & Routing
concepts.description: Detects if the phone is on the local network with the NAS to decide whether the VPN is needed.

concepts.title: VPN Controller
concepts.description: Automatically enables the VPN before backup (only if not on the local NAS network) and disables it after.
concepts.notes: Uses Android Intents to trigger installed third-party VPN apps (like WireGuard or OpenVPN).

concepts.title: SMB / CIFS Client
concepts.description: Handles file transfers to the local network NAS over the SMB protocol.

concepts.title: One-Way Archive Engine
concepts.description: Compares local files with the NAS and uploads new or changed files.
concepts.notes: Strictly one-way archive: files deleted on the phone remain on the NAS. Built with minimal, reusable core elements.

concepts.title: Transfer Resiliency Protocol
concepts.description: Handles file collisions, network drops, wait times, error management, and resumes partially copied files.
concepts.notes: Crucial for large backups over unstable Wi-Fi or VPNs.

concepts.title: Diagnostic Logger
concepts.description: Captures and stores structured logs of all errors, network drops, and transfer issues for user debugging.

concepts.title: File Filter & Limits Engine
concepts.description: Manages file size constraints and file type filtering (e.g., ignoring temp files or oversized videos).

concepts.title: SMS & Call Log Extractor
concepts.description: Reads system SMS messages and Call History logs and formats them as JSON.
concepts.notes: JSON format chosen specifically for easy rendering on personal websites. Requires native Android permissions.

concepts.title: Global Storage Scanner
concepts.description: Scans user-selected local directories for new or modified files across the entire device storage.
concepts.notes: Requires Android's MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (All Files Access) permission to reach beyond media files and standard directories.

concepts.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD
concepts.description: Automated pipeline to build the Android App Bundle (AAB) and push it directly to the Google Play Console.

concepts.title: Free / Open Source License
concepts.description: The repository and app are distributed under a free open-source license (e.g., MIT or GPLv3).
